title: NASUR Module Registry
description: Every NASUR module, its route, PDCA stage, build phase and status. Built-in views live in js/core/app.js; module files live under js/modules/.

pdca_stages.title: Plan
pdca_stages.summary: Decide what must be controlled and prepare for it.

pdca_stages.title: Do
pdca_stages.summary: Carry out the work, controls and learning.

pdca_stages.title: Act
pdca_stages.summary: Close actions, verify fixes and keep records accurate.

pdca_stages.title: Continual Improvement
pdca_stages.summary: Learn from experience and grow your competence.

pdca_stages.title: System
pdca_stages.summary: Core tools that support every stage.

modules.title: Home
modules.description: JARVIS command center: greeting, quick actions, today's summary, open and overdue actions.

modules.title: All Modules
modules.description: Every NASUR module, grouped by area or by PDCA stage.

modules.title: Settings
modules.description: Language, time zone, units, date format, week start, theme and privacy options.

modules.title: Clients & Projects
modules.description: Clients and projects with instant switching and separate data for each.

modules.title: Career & Competency
modules.description: Your role, target role, skills matrix, competency evidence and learning roadmap (advisory only).

modules.title: Workspace Layout
modules.description: Dashboard layout based on your role, industry, experience and personal preferences.

modules.title: Daily Work
modules.description: Start work day, plan, site walk, meetings, follow-ups and end-of-day summary.

modules.title: Observations
modules.description: Record unsafe acts, unsafe conditions and good practices, then follow them through to closure.

modules.title: Decision Support
modules.description: Guided steps: what you see, what to check, possible hazards, controls, who to inform. Guidance only.

modules.title: Actions
modules.description: One shared tracker for follow-ups from observations, inspections, audits, incidents and risk assessments.

modules.title: Inspections
modules.description: Checklist inspections with findings, photos, linked actions and closure.

modules.title: Risk Management
modules.description: Risk assessments, JSA/JHA, configurable risk matrix, hazard register and controls.

modules.title: Permit Drafts
modules.description: Draft permit-to-work paperwork and check prerequisites. NASUR never authorizes permits.

modules.title: Incidents
modules.description: Incidents, near misses and investigations with root cause analysis, CAPA and human sign-off.

modules.title: Audits
modules.description: Internal and site audits with findings, CAPA, evidence and verification.

modules.title: Emergency Preparedness
modules.description: Emergency contacts, procedures, muster points, equipment checks and drill records.

modules.title: Learn
modules.description: Beginner to advanced HSE lessons, quizzes, practice scenarios and revision.

modules.title: Machines & Equipment
modules.description: Machine and equipment safety: hazards, controls, inspection points and required PPE.

modules.title: Toolbox Talks
modules.description: Create, deliver and log Toolbox Talks with attendance and multilingual output.

modules.title: Workplace Language
modules.description: Safety phrases in Tamil, English, Hindi and Arabic with pronunciation and practical context.

modules.title: Career Portfolio
modules.description: Your personal record of lessons, Toolbox Talks, inspections and lessons learned, kept separate from employer records.

modules.title: Knowledge Library
modules.description: Your uploaded guides and notes, searchable and clearly separated from general HSE knowledge.

modules.title: My Safety Memory
modules.description: Personal notes, lessons learned and reminders.

modules.title: Report Check
modules.description: Check report drafts for spelling, missing fields and date errors. You approve every change.

modules.title: Document Control
modules.description: Document register with revisions, review dates and superseded status.

modules.title: Analytics
modules.description: Charts and metrics from your saved records, with filters and Power BI-ready export.

modules.title: Data & Backup
modules.description: Back up, restore, export and erase your data.

modules.title: HSE Policy
modules.description: HSE policy statements and communication records.

modules.title: HSE Objectives
modules.description: HSE objectives and targets with progress tracking.

modules.title: KPIs
modules.description: Leading and lagging safety indicators with trends.

modules.title: Management Review
modules.description: Management review inputs, decisions and follow-up.

modules.title: Training Matrix
modules.description: Training and competency matrix for people and roles.

modules.title: Contractor Management
modules.description: Contractor prequalification, induction and performance records.

modules.title: Management of Change
modules.description: Change requests, risk review, approvals and outcomes.

modules.title: Legal Register
modules.description: Applicable laws and regulations with compliance status.

modules.title: Environmental Management
modules.description: Environmental aspects, waste, spills and monitoring.

modules.title: Occupational Health
modules.description: Health surveillance and exposure monitoring records.

modules.title: Camp & Hostel Safety
modules.description: Accommodation, camp and hostel safety checks: fire, exits, housekeeping, sanitation, electrical.
